text_block_list.name: Smiling People
text_block_list.text:
—Oguri~! Thank you~! You really are a 
star, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
(That dream again...? It really is nice 
seeing everyone smiling...)

A day off. I came for mountain climbing, 
but intermittent rain has made the footing 
terrible. As I wondered whether to turn 
back—

Still, we cannot overlook you pushing 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for worrying about me. But that 
handkerchief was a gift from my daughter.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I grew up at the foot of this 
mountain, so it's practically my backyard!

A climber speaks with a troubled look. 
Looking closely, she is talking to horse 
girls from Tracen Academy.

Listening in, it appears they are trying 
to stop this climber from heading back up 
the mountain.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
She mentioned leaving something behind at 
the summit and wishes to go back for it, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The trail ahead is muddy and treacherous. 
Even for us, who are accustomed to heavy 
tracks, it was arduous.

Indeed, climbing up this rough path would 
be dangerous. Just as I thought about 
helping persuade her to give up—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Would you please leave this to me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I will go and search for it, so please 
wait at the shrine at the mountain's foot.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
But you just came down, didn't you? Aren't 
you tired...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I am fine. I will be right back.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
...My, she's so fast! Seeing her run, it's 
just like—

And so, we headed down the mountain to 
wait for Oguri Cap's return.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, ma'am. Were you about to 
say something when you saw Oguri-san 
earlier?

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's right. I couldn't help 
thinking she looked just like the 
"Messenger" from the local legend.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Could it be... the tale passed down at 
this shrine about the messenger of the 
gods?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
They say that when someone is in trouble 
on the mountain, the gods dispatch a 
messenger upon a whirlwind.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. When I heard that story as a 
child, I used to imagine what that 
"Messenger" would look like.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Surely someone remarkably beautiful and 
kind. Running as though commanding the 
wind itself.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text: Yes, just like that—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Forgive me for the wait.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Is this the item you were looking for?

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is it, no mistake! Thank you so 
much, I really must repay you somehow!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No, please don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, I had a dream this 
morning where many people were smiling 
happily.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So, well... I simply wanted to see joyful 
faces rather than sorrowful ones. ...That 
is all.
choice_data_list: Maybe it was a divine revelation?
You helped someone, so be proud of it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A revelation from the gods? To me?
(Whoooosh—)

At that moment, a refreshing breeze 
drifted through the shrine grounds. A 
pleasant wind that filled the heart with 
peace.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...What a lovely breeze. It cools down my 
body after that run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Perhaps the gods are expressing 
their gratitude to you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Could that be true? If so, I am glad.

Just like the dream Oguri Cap had seen, 
the day concluded with smiles gracing 
everyone's faces.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My, what a fascinating story... Oguri-san, 
do you remember anything else from that 
dream?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Standing in that line, I feel 
like I saw Tome-san and even my 
grandfather—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
People dear to you...? Perhaps that is 
because it carries a stronger emotional 
appeal to your heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps even God has a wish He desires to 
fulfill so deeply that He sends people 
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A wish to fulfill, huh...

Divine revelation or not, Oguri Cap 
succeeded in bringing smiles to people's 
faces through her helping hands.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Your proactive initiative to take 
action yourself is something I must learn 
from.

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
You were truly a lifesaver. Next time, 
I'll be sure to come visit Tracen Academy 
with a thank-you gift.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, please don't worry about it at all. It 
served as good training for me as well.

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. In that case, I'll go cheer for you 
at your races instead. Please show me your 
wonderful running again.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? That... makes me really happy. 
I'll work hard to show you a great race.

Through her genuine, selfless kindness, 
Oguri Cap gained yet another fan.
